mapper.select: /* selectSellerMdAmUserInfoList */ SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME_LOC, A.USER_NAME_ENG, A.USER_NAME_ENG, A.LANG, A.USER_TYPE, NVL(A.MAIL_RECV_FLAG,'N') AS MAIL_RECV_FLAG, NVL(A.SMS_RECV_FLAG,'N') AS SMS_RECV_FLAG, A.EMAIL, A.ZIP_CODE, A.MOBILE_PHONE, A.ADDRESS_LOC, A.ADDRESS_ENG, A.PHONE_NUMBER, A.FAX_NUMBER, A.COUNTRY, A.CITY, A.ZIP_KEY, NVL(A.ADDRESS_LOC1, A.ADDRESS_LOC) AS ADDRESS_LOC1, A.ADDRESS_LOC2, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE = A.COUNTRY) AS COUNTRY_TEXT, NVL( (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M004' AND CODE = A.CITY), (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE = A.CITY) ) AS CITY_TEXT, B.COM_CODE, B.COM_NAME_LOC, B.IRS_NO, A.DEPARTMENT, A.POSITION, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND CODE = A.DEPARTMENT AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) DEPARTMENT_TEXT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C003' AND CODE = A.POSITION AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) POSITION_TEXT, A.TWO_FACTOR_YN FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE UPPER(A.USER_ID) = UPPER(#{st_user_id}) AND A.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: /* updateSellerMdAmUsePwd */ UPDATE ICOMLUSR SET PASSWORD = #{PSW}, PASS_CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), PASSWORD_TYPE = 'C' WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND COM_CODE = #{COM_CODE}
